QuestInfo.name: Basic Fitness Training 2
QuestInfo.0: Basic Training continues. If you want to start the second stage of Basic Training, you should talk to #b#p1201000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1201000# says that this time you have to go to #b#m140020100##k and defeat some #r#o0100132#s#k. Come to think of it, #p1201000# seems different from the time you first saw her, back when she had that mystical aura about her...

0.0: Shall we continue with your Basic Training? Before accepting, please make sure you have properly equipped your sword and your skills and potions are readily accessible in Hotkeys.

yes.0: Alright. This time, let's have you defeat #r#o0100132#s#k, which are slightly more powerful than #o0100131#s. Head over to #b#m140020100##k and defeat #r15#k of them. That should help you build your strength. Alright! Let's do this!

no.0: Are you not ready to hunt the #o0100132#s yet? Always proceed if and only if you are fully ready. There's nothing worse than engaging in battles without sufficient preparation.

1.0: Oh, you were able to defeat all the #o0100132#s like I asked? You do look like you have gotten a bit stronger. Somewhere on the scale of...penguins flapping their wings?

yes.0: Train a bit more, and you may one day be strong enough to carry a penguin all by yourself. Now talk to me when you're ready to move on to the next level.

mob.0: I don't think you have defeated all the #r#o0100132#s#k yet. Please let me know when you have defeated all #r15#k of them. It's not that hard, is it? Come on, head to #b#m140020100##k.
